parameters.code: var c=UnityEngine.Object.FindFirstObjectByType<BattleCity.ArenaController>(); var s=c.Session; s.SetPaused(false); s.AdvanceFrame(0,BattleCity.PlayerButtons.None); while(s.Clock.Tick<601){s.Bullets.Clear();s.AdvanceFrame(BattleCity.LogicClock.StepSeconds,BattleCity.PlayerButtons.None);} s.SetPaused(true); var carrier=System.Linq.Enumerable.Single(s.Tanks,t=>t.CarriesPickup); return new { tick=s.Clock.Tick, carrier=carrier.DefinitionId, hp=carrier.HitPoints, alive=s.PlayerTank.IsAlive, spawned=s.EnemyWave.SpawnedCount };
